query: why did wasm modules abort with an overflow after tens of thousands of embedder invocations
notes: the symptom and its cause are only in the commit body (dev history, PR #1294): the trampoline's Result came back through a stack slot in the handler's own frame, its address escaped, so LLVM could not make the handler's final call a sibling call and every host call left ~150-200 bytes behind; an 8 MiB thread overflowed after 40,000-60,000 host calls. exec.rs:564-572 explains the mechanism but not the symptom. The subject ('stitch: a host call no longer leaves its handler's frame on the native stack') shares no words with the query.
